### Summary of Audit & Findings
1. **API Compliance**:
   - Constants `WHITE = "W"`, `BLACK = "B"`, and `NONE = ""` are correctly defined.
   - [`Board`](file:///private/var/folders/z3/tpy284jj297ck601rpn41r1m0000gp/T/harness_eval_go-counting_arm_b_j1s_j5ki/go_counting.py#L12-L105) implements [`territory(x, y)`](file:///private/var/folders/z3/tpy284jj297ck601rpn41r1m0000gp/T/harness_eval_go-counting_arm_b_j1s_j5ki/go_counting.py#L61-L81) and [`territories()`](file:///private/var/folders/z3/tpy284jj297ck601rpn41r1m0000gp/T/harness_eval_go-counting_arm_b_j1s_j5ki/go_counting.py#L83-L105) matching signatures and docstring specifications.
   - Raises `ValueError("Invalid coordinate")` exactly on out-of-bounds coordinates.
   - Querying an in-bounds stone coordinate correctly returns `(NONE, set())`.

2. **Algorithmic Correctness**:
   - Strictly enforces 4-connected orthogonal traversal (`_DIRS`); diagonal connections and diagonal stone adjacencies are excluded.
   - Flood-fill BFS via `collections.deque` eliminates recursion depth risks.
   - Territory ownership logic accurately distinguishes single-color boundaries, neutral/contested boundaries (`NONE`), and boards with no stones (`NONE`).

3. **Coordinate System & Off-by-One**:
   - Coordinates `(x, y)` consistently represent `(column, row)` with zero-based indexing.
   - Grid access [`_cell(x, y)`](file:///private/var/folders/z3/tpy284jj297ck601rpn41r1m0000gp/T/harness_eval_go-counting_arm_b_j1s_j5ki/go_counting.py#L27-L28) correctly indexes `_grid[y][x]`.
   - Bounds check [`_in_bounds(x, y)`](file:///private/var/folders/z3/tpy284jj297ck601rpn41r1m0000gp/T/harness_eval_go-counting_arm_b_j1s_j5ki/go_counting.py#L24-L25) correctly avoids negative wrap-around and handles rectangular/single-line boards.

4. **Performance & Complexity**:
   - [`territories()`](file:///private/var/folders/z3/tpy284jj297ck601rpn41r1m0000gp/T/harness_eval_go-counting_arm_b_j1s_j5ki/go_counting.py#L83-L105) processes each empty component once using `visited` tracking in optimal $O(W \times H)$ time and space.
   - Caller mutations of returned sets or input lists cannot mutate internal state.

The full findings, comprehensive edge-case audit results, and recommendations have been written to [`02_REVIEW.md`](file:///private/var/folders/z3/tpy284jj297ck601rpn41r1m0000gp/T/harness_eval_go-counting_arm_b_j1s_j5ki/02_REVIEW.md).
